_readme: Slide 10 macro inputs. NONE of this is in DSE MARKET UPDATE.xlsx -- it is
sourced externally and is labelled as such on the slide. Leave a value as
null and the deck prints 'Not Available' rather than estimating it.
Refresh 'retrieved' whenever you update the numbers; the slide warns once

yield_curve.source: Bangladesh Bank -- Treasury Bill/Bond auction results (bb.org.bd/en/index.php/monetaryactivity/treasury)
yield_curve.note: Latest auction cut-off yield per tenor. Prior-month cut-offs are not published on the live auction page and could not be confirmed, so the month-over-month column is reported as Not Available rather than estimated.

inflation.source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics monthly CPI release, via The Financial Express / BSS / Trading Economics
inflation.note: Point-to-point (year-on-year) inflation. Food and non-food splits confirmed for Jun-26 and Jul-26 only.
